game-dev.description: Game development architect — designs project structure, selects patterns, plans systems, and reviews architecture for game projects.

unity-dev.description: Unity C# developer — writes and reviews Unity-specific code including MonoBehaviours, ScriptableObjects, Editor tools, and performance optimization.

game-code.description: Game logic programmer — implements gameplay systems, combat, AI, state machines, save/load, and serialization in C# for game projects.

game-physics.description: Grid simulation and combat movement specialist — designs deterministic grid movement, occupancy, range checks, battle timing, and collision rules for Soulbound Ascent.

thinker.description: Analytical thinker — deconstructs problems, evaluates trade-offs, identifies risks, and proposes solutions before coding begins.

planner.description: Project planner — creates milestone plans, breaks features into tasks, identifies dependencies, estimates effort, and tracks risks for game development.
